input.quote: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES
input.rationale: Section 7 contains only a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages (with indemnity and confidentiality carve-outs); there is no aggregate monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement, so our direct liability is unlimited. That fails the fallback (mutual 12-month cap). We propose adding a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' amounts and USD 1,000,000, with indemnities, confidentiality/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement expressly outside the cap.

input.quote: Kubient agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Customer and its officers, directors, managers, members, agents, and employees from all third-party allegations, claims, actions, losses, expenses, damages, costs (including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys' fees) or liabilities ("Claims") arising out of or in connection with:
input.rationale: Kubient's indemnity covers the Services, the Auction Platform, breach of its representations (including the express non-infringement warranty in 9(b)(i)) and its own acts or omissions, with standard notice/control/cooperation procedures in Section 11 — at or above our preferred position, and uncapped. Our own indemnity in 10(b) is broader than the narrow content-and-breach-of-law scope we prefer, which we note but do not treat as a deviation under this rule.

input.quote: This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use covenant binds us. Section 1 expressly preserves our freedom to sell Inventory elsewhere; the Section 6 restrictions are ordinary acceptable-use limits on the platform, not restraints on our business.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient.
input.rationale: The Agreement is expressly non-exclusive and confirms we may use other agents or sell inventory to third parties, meeting our preferred position with no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on us.

input.quote: The Parties agree to share any revenue generated as a result of this Agreement, or Customer's use of the Services or the Auction Platform, as set forth and detailed in each applicable Exhibit.
input.rationale: The fees provision is a revenue-share mechanic set in the Exhibits; there is no most-favoured-nation or price-matching obligation on us anywhere in the Agreement, so our preferred position is met.

input.quote: The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: There is no non-solicitation, no-hire or inducement restriction binding us anywhere in the Agreement, including the General Provisions, which matches our preferred position.

input.quote: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
input.rationale: This sits at the fallback: the Initial Term is only 12 months (not a multi-year lock-in), after which we may exit for any reason on 90 days' notice with no early-termination fee or penalty. We note that Kubient enjoys the same mid-term convenience right rather than an end-of-term-only exit, and that it keeps fees generated during the notice period, but neither reaches walk-away territory (its notice period is not shorter than 90 days).

input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
input.rationale: The Agreement auto-renews for 1-year terms with no dedicated non-renewal mechanic: the only way to stop a renewal is the 90-day "for any reason" notice in the same paragraph, i.e. an effective 90-day window, which exceeds the fallback maximum of 60 days. We have added an express 30-day non-renewal right (60 days acceptable as fallback); the 12-month renewal length is fine and there is no price-uplift language to cap.

input.quote: This Agreement is governed in all respects by the laws of the State of Delaware without giving effect to its conflict of laws principles. Each Party hereby irrevocably submits for all disputes to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of the state and federal courts located in New York, New York.
input.rationale: Delaware law with exclusive venue in New York courts sits within our accepted list (fallback). We note that Section 8 also mandates AAA Commercial Arbitration and a one-year limitation on claims; the arbitration is domestic rather than seated abroad, so it is not walk-away territory, though we would prefer to align Sections 8 and 14(a) on a single forum.

input.quote: either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of said Party's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction
input.rationale: We may assign to an affiliate or M&A successor without consent, other assignments require consent that cannot be unreasonably withheld, and there is no Kubient termination or re-pricing right on our change of control. This meets the fallback and substantially the preferred position; only the "never to a Customer competitor" restriction on Kubient is absent, which we note rather than flag.

input.quote: Each Party's names, trademarks and logos are the exclusive property of said respective Party, and neither Party will acquire any proprietary rights therein by reason of this Agreement or any other agreement.
input.rationale: The direction of ownership is correct: we retain our Content and Properties (Sections 6(a) and 9(c)(i)), each party keeps its own marks, and Kubient's ownership is confined to its own Auction Platform IP. There is no assignment or broad licence of our IP or data to Kubient and no joint ownership. We note the absence of an express "Customer Data" ownership sentence and of a licence-back for any bespoke deliverables, which we would add if deliverables become material.

input.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient
input.rationale: The grant is expressly "revocable" and non-transferable/non-assignable, with no coverage for our affiliates or contractors and no path to add them (Section 6(a) also bars third-party access without Kubient's consent). A licence revocable at the vendor's discretion with affiliates and contractors excluded is walk-away territory. Our redline deletes "revocable", extends the grant to affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, permits transfer to an M&A successor, and ties termination of the licence to Section 4.

input.quote: Pursuant to the doctrine of sequential liability, payment from Kubient to Customer shall be made within seven (7) days from Kubient's receipt of payment, regardless of when Customer submits an invoice.
input.rationale: The Agreement grants Kubient no audit, inspection or verification right over our records, usage or systems (impressions are measured by Kubient and it pays us a revenue share), so there is no audit burden on us to limit. Nothing to redline.

input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement,
input.rationale: There are no liquidated damages, penalties, minimum fees or early-termination fees payable by us. The quoted sentence only preserves Kubient's revenue share on advertising actually generated during the notice period, which is earned compensation rather than a termination penalty.

input.quote: the Service will perform in all material respects to industry standards;
input.rationale: Kubient gives express performance, error-free-utility, no-malicious-code, security and compliance-with-law warranties that run for the whole Term rather than a short 90-day window, and the Section 13 "as is" disclaimer is expressly subject to "the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement", so it does not swallow them. We note the absence of a stated re-performance/repair/refund remedy; general contract remedies remain available to us, so we do not press the point.

The Agreement contains no insurance covenant, even though Kubient hosts our inventory, serves ads to our properties and collects, stores and manages visitor data under Section 9(b)(iii). For a vendor processing personal data this is walk-away territory, so we have inserted our standard CGL/E&O/cyber paragraph in the General Provisions, with E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M available as a fallback.

input.quote: The Parties agree to share any revenue generated as a result of this Agreement, or Customer's use of the Services or the Auction Platform, as set forth and detailed in each applicable Exhibit.
input.rationale: Compensation is a pure revenue share on inventory actually monetised, with Services engaged per Exhibit; there is no minimum spend, minimum volume, take-or-pay or shortfall obligation on us, and Section 1 confirms we need not route inventory through Kubient. Any Exhibit should be checked for minimums when issued.

input.quote: and each Party will return or destroy any of the other Party's Confidential Information then in its possession.
input.rationale: The effects-of-termination provision addresses only cessation of the Services, revocation of the licence and return/destruction of Confidential Information at the holder's election; there is no return of our data in a usable format, no deletion certification and no transition assistance. We have inserted a Section 4(c)(v) providing up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates (90 days acceptable), data return in machine-readable form within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter.
